description: duplicate with `parent` (O11 lane, traditional web): the Preparation is the ONLY one of its block, so pasting into the same parent always fails ('Object should be null' from the platform; the kernel refuses beforehand, tests/jobs-negative/duplicate-single-slot.json). With `parent` the native copy goes to ANOTHER block that does not have a Preparation yet, with the Start and the End inside. The `get` by $block/#IPreparation only resolves if the copy ended up in the destination block.

ops._why: the copy is born in the block $into, not in $from
proves the destination: fails if the block does not have the copied Preparation
the original stays in the source block
